a file-management dashboard

Product·by @UI_Farhan·2026-08-31·inspora page·original post

What it is

Static comp: dark file-management dashboard ('Filenns.') floating over a bright sky photograph - sidebar with workspace/storage sections, recent-uploads card row, full file table with avatar stacks and status pills.

Media

Frame-by-frame

image
Full desktop comp: left sidebar (search, MY WORKSPACE: My File/Shared/Recent/Favorites/Trash; AI TOOLS: AI Insight/AI Categories; STORAGE: Storage Overview/Backup & Restore/Storage Plans; user card + storage meter + Upgrade button). Main: breadcrumb, Upload/View/Sort by/Share controls, 'Recent uploads' 5 preview cards with colorful thumbnails, 'My Files' table (Name, AI Category, Last modified, Shared with avatar stack, Status 'Synced' green dot pill, Size) with folder and file rows. Window floats over a pixel-dithered sky photo.

Build prompt

Recreate this dark file-manager dashboard as a static comp. Outer: the app window (radius 16, border white/8, shadow) centered over a dithered sky photograph. Sidebar 240px: app logo 'Filenns.', search input with kbd chip, section labels in 11px caps (MY WORKSPACE / AI TOOLS / STORAGE), nav rows with 16px icons, bottom user card (avatar, name, email, progress bar '245.6 GB of 1 TB used', dark 'Upgrade Storage' button). Main column: breadcrumb, toolbar (primary Upload, View, Sort by, Share buttons with icons), 'Recent uploads' horizontal card row (5 cards: thumbnail mosaic, name, date), then a 'My Files' table: header row with sort carets, rows = checkbox+icon+name, AI Category, Last modified, avatar stack (4 overlapping 20px circles), green-dot 'Synced' pill, size, kebab. Folders use folder icons, files use type-tinted icons. Palette: #0B0B0C bg, #161618 surfaces, white/85 text, green #22C55E status. 13px table text, 12px meta.
